mstts:express-as.prosody: Imagine a world where the push for endless economic growth collides head-on with the pressing need to protect our climate. It’s a crossroads—where the drive for profit and expansion meets the planet’s own limits, and suddenly, we can’t look away from the tension. If you’ve ever wondered why saving the environment feels so tangled up with the way our economies work, you’re not alone. Together, we’re about to step into the heart of this conflict, guided by Naomi Klein’s thought-provoking book, This Changes Everything: Capitalism vs. The Climate. Klein doesn’t just ask us to worry about melting ice caps or rising seas—she invites us to question the values and systems that shape our collective future. As the impacts of unchecked emissions and relentless resource extraction become impossible to ignore, the conversation turns. It’s not just about finding technical solutions—it’s about asking bigger questions: What does justice look like in a warming world? How do we redefine progress? Through Klein’s lens, we’ll explore the resistance from powerful interests who want to keep things just as they are, and the hope sparked by grassroots movements imagining a new way of living—one that’s more in tune with the earth. On this journey, we’ll discover why facing the climate crisis could be our chance to build a fairer, more sustainable future together. So, let’s get curious, stay open, and see what unfolds when we dare to imagine real change.
